summary.text: Redpath is the Libertarian Party candidate. A Findlay, Ohio, native and retired business-valuation consultant now living in Perrysburg, he describes himself as a nine-time Libertarian candidate for public office and chaired the Libertarian National Committee from 2006 to 2010. His campaign focuses on reducing federal spending, repealing tariffs, and a non-interventionist foreign policy.

paragraphs.text: Born and raised in Findlay, Ohio; graduated from Findlay High School. As a teenager he worked at Findlay radio stations WFIN and WHMQ.
Earned a BA in economics and political science from Indiana University Bloomington (1978) and an MBA from the University of Chicago (1980).
Early finance and accounting career: auditor at Arthur Andersen in Cincinnati (1980-1982), WISH-TV in Indianapolis (1982-1983), ABC (1983-1984) and NBC (1984-1985) in New York.

Spent a 38-year career in business valuation focused on media and telecommunications, as vice president at BIA Advisory Services (1985-2020) and later managing director at Summit Ridge Group. He holds CPA, CFA (retired) and Accredited Senior Appraiser (retired) credentials.

Joined the Libertarian Party in 1984; served on the Libertarian National Committee for 24 years in total, including as chair from 2006 to 2010, and has led the party's ballot-access efforts. Says he was inducted into the Libertarian Party Hall of Liberty in 2016.

Has run for office repeatedly as a Libertarian: Virginia governor (2001), U.S. Senate (2008) and U.S. House (2010, 2014) in Virginia, and in Illinois for U.S. House (2020) and U.S. Senate (2022). He was Treasurer of the election-reform group FairVote (1995-2020).
